notifications.title: Optional: a one-off event-day run for UK inflation on Wed 21 Oct
notifications.detail: ONS publishes September CPI at 07:00 London = 11:30 IST. Without a one-off run, the research run that night puts it in the feed and the 22 Oct 04:07 video run makes the video, one day later.
notifications.fix: 1. Copy improvement/research/events/2026-10-21-uk-cpi.json to improvement/events/ on main. 2. claude.ai/code → Routines → New → one-off on 21 Oct at 11:45 IST, this repo, prompt: 'Read generator/prompts/event_day.md and follow it exactly.' 3. Nothing is needed for the Fed on 28 Oct: the decision lands at 23:30 IST, just before the 23:47 research run, which feeds it to the 04:07 video run.

notifications.title: A published Short shows the same amount two different ways
notifications.detail: v-20261017-04 ('How much do impulse orders really cost you in 15 years?') shows '₹6.5 L gone' at 15.9 s but 'Put in ₹6.4 L' at 26.7 s, and 'Worth ₹16.3 L' at 26.7 s but '₹16.5 L' on the bar at 32.2 s. It was made by the old money_leak_meter template, which no longer exists; the improver adopted a check (same-figure-same-text) so new videos can't do this.
notifications.fix: Only the owner handles uploads: in YouTube Studio, open that Short and either set it to Private/Unlisted or leave it up (the gap is a rounding and convention difference, not a wrong claim). Nothing to change in the repo.

notifications.title: Optional: listen to two better-rated voices for the narrator
notifications.detail: Kokoro's own grades: af_heart A, af_bella A-, bf_emma (British) B-, but am_michael, am_fenrir and am_puck only C+. am_michael narrated 5 of the last 9 Shorts. British bf_emma could suit the UK stories (pound videos). Voices are picked by your ear, so research hasn't proposed a change.
notifications.fix: 1. On your computer: bash scripts/setup-voice.sh, then make a short sample with bf_emma and am_michael (renderer/engine/voice.py speak_timed). 2. If you like bf_emma, ask the improver (or edit NARRATOR_VOICES in renderer/timeline/build.py) to add it, for example for GBP scripts only. 3. Otherwise ignore this.
